g.aria-label: If f is continuous on [a, b] and G′(x) = f(x) for
ALL x ∈ [a, b], then ∫_a^b f(x) dx = G(b) − G(a)
Running example: ∫₀² x/(1+x²) dx = [½ log(1+x²)]₀² = ½ log 5 ≈ 0.804719
Singular Antiderivative Trap: Why G′(x) = f(x) Must Hold at EVERY Point of [a, b]
Why it fails: G(x) = −1/x blows up at x = 0 ∈ [−1, 1]; both ∫_{−1}⁰ x⁻² dx and ∫₀¹ x⁻² dx diverge to +∞!
